card.name: Verbs of what a device does
card.fires_on: Present-tense action verbs right after a thing-subject (device, panel, tissue, system) in explanations of how something works, such as convert, changes, absorb, controls, process.

modes.example: The discs<< absorb>> shock and make the spine flexible.
